chapters.title: The cost of being eventually correct
AI is only as real-time as integration

takeaways: Polling-based middleware keeps data only eventually correct, which costs revenue, widens security exposure windows and degrades AI output.
Latency to value, the time between a business event and the organization acting on it, is a better integration metric than uptime or throughput.

Start by replacing one high-volume batch sync with Event Grid, Service Bus, Dataverse webhooks or Microsoft Graph change notifications, then scale through an event catalog and governance in the platform.
hook: Scheduled syncs and polling middleware quietly tax your enterprise with stale data, slower decisions and weaker AI. This episode gives IT leaders and integration architects a business case and roadmap for moving to event-driven architecture with Azure Event Grid, Service Bus and Microsoft Graph change notifications.
